changelog: v0.8.2: 1) Pure Immersive View: Added pure immersed 3D view preserving the full 360° space environment (Study Hall, Zen Garden, Penthouse, Cafe, Passthrough) without avatar obstruction or background music, keeping the interactive 3D console active; 2) Automatic Live Mode Activation: Entering Immersive View automatically activates hands-free Live Mode; 3) Full State Snapshot & Exact Restoration: Exiting cleanly restores pre-entry state (avatar visibility, floor shadow, background music state, and Live Mode on/off state); 4) In-VR 3D Panel Minimize & Reopen: Added ➖ Hide Panel button in 3D console header to collapse the HUD into a compact floating 👁️ Reopen Panel pill, providing unobstructed scene visibility; 5) Quest 3 Left Stick & Android Touch Locomotion: Enabled direct avatar locomotion via Quest 3 Left Thumbstick (axes[0]/axes[1]) and Android 2-finger touch drag.
